rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the act or transaction of making a payment.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 fu6 fun2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the actual sum of money paid, owed, or being transferred rather than the act itself.

example.english: Please make the full payment by the end of the month.
example.traditional: 請於月底前支付全數款項。
example.jyutping: cing2 jyu1 jyut6 dai2 cin4 zi1 fu6 cyun4 sou3 fun2 hong6

rows.note: Use this when the payment is compensation or a reward given in return for work, help, or another act.

example.english: The payment for this job is quite attractive.
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 ge3 bou3 cau4 gei2 kap1 jan5
